SELECT PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID, PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR, PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET, PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG, PRODUCT.ISSUER, PRODUCT.ISSUE_TYPE, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE else PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE end as ONMARKET_DATE, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else PRODUCT_ADD.APPEAR_MARKET_ID end as APPEAR_MARKET_ID, PRODUCT.VDATE, PRODUCT.MDATE, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_9, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_10, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_11 BOND_TYPE, PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES, PRODUCT.CCY, PRODUCT.ISSUE_PRICE, PRODUCT.REMARK, ISSUE.INT_TYPE, ISSUE.PAY_CYCLE, ISSUE.REFER_YIELD, ISSUE.MIN_PER_TAMT, ISSUE.MAX_PER_UTAMT, ISSUE.ISSUE_SDATE, ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE, ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS, ISSUE.TENDER_TYPE, ISSUE.TENDER_TARGET, ISSUE.ISSUE_STYLE, ISSUE.PLAN_ISSUE_AMT, ISSUE.PAY_DATE, ISSUE.PAY_EDATE, ISSUE.PAY_EDATE, ISSUE.ASSIGN_REGDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TOTAL ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TOTAL.FINPROD_ID and TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F32' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID AND PRODUCT_TYPE.BRANCH = '0' LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO ON PRODUCT.ISSUER = CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT2 ON PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE = PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ID
PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
